_note: Everything that runs without being asked, as of 15 Oct 2026: two launchd jobs, one cloud routine (paused) and the two Claude Code hooks in .claude/settings.json.

routines.label: IG Vault Sync
routines.desc: launchd: transcribes new reels into Content/Instagram/Scripts, refreshes 30 days of analytics, rebuilds the indexes

routines.label: IG Token Refresh
routines.desc: launchd: refreshes the Instagram long-lived token so the API registry stays authenticated

routines.label: Weekly Content Post
routines.desc: Cloud routine: posts the week's content schedule to #daily-updates. Paused 13 Oct 2026.

routines.label: Session Load
routines.desc: SessionStart hook: loads every automation note and the chat index

routines.label: Chat Logging
routines.desc: UserPromptSubmit hook: appends the prompt to Memory/Chats/.raw before Claude sees it
